character: A towering giant of a man, seven and a half feet tall, broad as a wardrobe. Deep sun-brown skin, shaved head, a thick black beard in heavy curled plaits bound with brass rings. A pale puckered scar across his throat and down his chest. A wide warm grin.
wardrobe: A long black red-lined captain's coat open over a bare chest, a red sash, a huge cutlass.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing on a ship's deck, hands on hips.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Swinging down onto a merchant ship's deck on a rope through cannon smoke, landing heavily, planks buckling, laughing.
